offering_description.value: Provides organizational and talent consulting to businesses. Consultants help clients design structures and roles, attract and retain talent, and develop their workforce. The firm uses a proprietary technology platform with analytics and generative AI to support its work.

quotes.quote: Korn Ferry’s organizational consulting services target the most critical challenges facing global businesses today: attracting, developing, motivating and retaining talent, as well as creating the right structures to support that talent.
Our One Korn Ferry technology platform incorporates analytics, generative AI, and proprietary IP to drive impact at scale with speed.

primary_services.value: Organizational strategy and design; talent attraction and retention consulting; rewards and benefits design; talent assessment and succession planning; workforce and leadership development
